english.note: This is the all-purpose casual abbreviation for a microphone.

examples.english: The concert is about to start, so quickly pass me the microphone.
examples.traditional: 演唱會就開始喇，快啲將個咪遞畀我。
examples.jyutping: jin2 coeng3 wui2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 laa3 faai3 di1 zoeng1 go3 mai1 dai6 bei2 ngo5

english.note: Use this casual spoken alternative when referring to the exact unit of length.

examples.english: It’s almost a mile from here to the MTR station.
examples.traditional: 由呢度行到地鐵站，差唔多一咪。
examples.jyutping: jau4 ni1 dou6 haang4 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 caa1 m4 do1 jat1 mai1
